checks.claim: 1839-09-10生剑桥、父Benjamin Peirce哈佛数学教授、1859毕业/1863化学学士、海岸与大地测量局三十余年（至1891-12-31）、1879-1884霍普金斯教逻辑（Sylvester主持）、1905 pragmaticism改名、1914-04-19卒于米尔福德、遗产售予哈佛与罗伊斯编文集。
checks.locator: Brief Biography：'born on September 10, 1839 in Cambridge, Massachusetts…died on April 19, 1914 in Milford, Pennsylvania'；'worked thereafter only for the U. S. Coast and Geodetic Survey (and constructing entries for the Century Dictionary) and writing book reviews for the Nation'；'teaching logic in the Department of Mathematics at Johns Hopkins University…headed by…J. J. Sylvester'；pragmaticism改名句

checks.claim: 1877-1878《科学逻辑的例证》六篇、《信念的确定》《如何使我们的观念清楚》、Pragmatic Maxim canonical statement。
checks.locator: 'this canonical statement of his Pragmatic Maxim in 1878 in How to Make our Ideas Clear: Consider what effects, which might conceivably have practical bearings…'
